run_distributed_inference: run distributed text generation with phi-2 model across multiple GPUs using accelerate PartialState
create_distributed_state: create a distributed state with PartialState for multi-GPU inference without an Accelerator
split_between_processes: split tokenized prompt batches across processes with split_between_processes and apply_padding
gather_object_results: gather generated completions from all processes with gather_object and deduplicate
